he.text: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־יִזְכֶּה וְכִי־יִצְדַּק יְלוּד אִשָּׁה׃ מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־תִפְקְדֶנּוּ לִבְקָרִים וְלִרְגָעִים תִּבְחָנֶנּוּ׃ יְיָ אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנוּ וְאַל־בַּחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנוּ׃ אַף־עַל־זֶה־פָּקַחְתָּ עֵינֶךָ וְאוֹתָנוּ תָבִיא בְמִשְׁפָּט עִמָּךְ׃

en.text: What is man that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman that he should be righteous? What is man that thou shouldst visit him every morning, and try him every moment! O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger! neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure. Thou openest thine eyes upon such an one too, and then bringest us into judgment with thee.
